lines.line: In training, Stack Overflow fires blocks from the top of its stack.
Its whip lashes out low, or straight up if you hold up.
The beam fires all five blocks at once.
It parries Claude's rod from the side, and ChatGPT's slab from above.
It crouches under Claude's fling, then double-taps to dash past.
Below the stage with no jumps left, it whips upward, grabs the ledge and climbs back up.
